title: Working Together to Address the Zika Outbreak in Singapore
what_it_is: Working Together to Address the Zika Outbreak in Singapore

sections.label: Zika cases and clusters
sections.summary: As of noon yesterday, 333 persons tested positive for Zika, including eight pregnant, involving seven clusters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: As of noon yesterday, 333 persons have tested positive for Zika, including eight who are pregnant, and involving seven clusters.

sections.label: WHO Zika emergency declaration
sections.summary: On 1 February 2016, WHO declared Brazil's microcephaly cluster, suspected linked to Zika, a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: On 1 February 2016, the World Health Organization (WHO) declared that the recent cluster of microcephaly cases in Brazil, which are suspected to be linked to Zika, constituted a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

sections.label: Three-pronged Zika action plan
sections.summary: Local transmission was expected due to Aedes mosquitoes, so an action plan with a three-pronged approach was put in place.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: When it did, we also expected to see local transmission, because of the presence of Aedes mosquitoes here.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Hence, we have put in place an action plan with a three-pronged approach: first, preparing for Zika; second, responding to initial cases; and third, managing Zika in the long term.

sections.label: Stepped-up Zika surveillance testing
sections.summary: From January, surveillance and testing were stepped up to over 500 samples monthly, mostly from people without travel history.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: From January this year, we stepped up our surveillance and testing efforts and increased the number of samples tested for Zika to more than 500 a month, a majority of them from people who had no travel history to Zika-affected areas.

sections.label: Four locally transmitted Zika cases
sections.summary: A lady was confirmed Zika-positive on 27 August, and that evening MOH announced four locally transmitted cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The following day, a lady visited the same GP clinic with similar symptoms and was referred to the CDC, as was arranged with MOH.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: She was confirmed as Zika-positive on 27 August.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Three other patients were preliminarily tested positive that day, pending confirmation tests.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: That very evening, MOH announced all four cases of locally transmitted Zika cases – one confirmed and three pending confirmation.

sections.label: Back-tracing raised case count
sections.summary: Active back-tracing raised confirmed Zika cases from one on 27 August to 41 on 28 August.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We obtained most of the results by the next day and included them in our subsequent announcement.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: This active back-tracing was why the number of confirmed Zika cases increased from one reported on 27 August to 41 on 28 August.

sections.label: Earliest case symptom onset
sections.summary: The analysis showed the earliest case had onset of symptoms on 31 July.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The analysis showed that the earliest case had onset of symptoms on 31 July.

sections.label: Referral of pregnant Zika patients
sections.summary: Doctors refer pregnant women testing positive for Zika to an obstetric or maternal-foetal medicine specialist for counselling and follow-up.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Pregnant women who are tested positive for Zika will be referred by their doctors to an obstetric or maternal-foetal medicine specialist for counselling and subsequent follow-up.

sections.label: Insect repellents at community clubs
sections.summary: PA worked with NEA to make insect repellents available to pregnant women at community clubs island-wide since last Saturday.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The People's Association (PA) has also worked with NEA and specially arranged for insect repellents to be available to pregnant women at community clubs island-wide since last Saturday.

sections.label: Sequencing Zika virus from patients
sections.summary: The National Public Health Laboratory and A*STAR's Bioinformatics Institute completed sequencing Zika virus from two patients and shared results publicly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The National Public Health Laboratory has worked with the Agency for Science, Technology and Research's (A*STAR's) Bioinformatics Institute to complete the sequencing of the Zika virus found in two patients here and shared their results publicly.

sections.label: Free Zika tests for pregnant women
sections.summary: Zika is a concern in pregnancy due to microcephaly risk, and free Zika tests are provided for symptomatic pregnant women and those whose male partners tested positive.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: However, Zika infection is a concern among pregnant women as some babies born to pregnant women with Zika infection may be at risk of developing microcephaly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We provide free Zika tests for the symptomatic pregnant women and those whose male partners have tested positive for Zika.

sections.label: Thanks and Zika trend caution
sections.summary: The speaker thanks grassroots leaders, volunteers and Singaporeans, says the long-term Zika trend is unclear, and warns against complacency even if daily numbers fall.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: I am grateful to many grassroots leaders and volunteers who helped to reach out to fellow residents on Zika and I want to thank all Singaporeans for helping us on the ground to eliminate mosquito breeding sites.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: It is still early days to ascertain what the long-term trend of Zika infections will be.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: We cannot afford to be complacent, even if we see day-to-day numbers coming down.

sections.label: Guarding against imported Zika cases
sections.summary: Zika virus still circulates in many countries including this region, so guarding against imported cases must continue even if the present outbreak is controlled.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Even if we can control the present outbreak, we will need to continue to guard against imported cases, as the Zika virus is still circulating among many countries, including several in this region.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: By working together, I am confident that we can succeed in managing Zika in the long term.

sections.label: WHO reported case numbers
sections.summary: WHO reported 2.2 million cases in 2010, rising to 3.2 million last year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: WHO reported 2.2 million cases in 2010, and this number has increased to 3.2 million last year.

sections.label: Gravitraps deployed around Singapore
sections.summary: NEA has deployed about 37,000 Gravitraps around Singapore, and this number will reach 48,000 by the end of the year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: NEA has deployed about 37,000 Gravitraps around Singapore and this number will reach 48,000 by the end of the year.

sections.label: Inspections and breeding habitats destroyed
sections.summary: About 850 officers inspect daily; between January and July about 748,000 inspections were conducted and more than 10,000 breeding habitats destroyed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Around 850 officers are deployed daily to do inspections island-wide.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Between January and July this year, we conducted about 748,000 inspections – 638,000 of these inspections were in homes and 4,400 in construction sites.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: More than 10,000 breeding habitats were destroyed during these inspections – about half were in homes and about 5% in construction sites.

sections.label: Enforcement and construction site breeding reduction
sections.summary: NEA issued SWOs, court notices and prosecutions, with about 2,750 ECOs, reducing inspected construction sites with mosquito breeding from 30% in the 1990s to about 9% today.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Between January and July this year, NEA issued around 50 SWOs, 410 Notices to Attend Courts and also proceeded with over 40 Court prosecutions of errant contractors for repeat offences.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: There are now around 2,750 ECOs to ensure good housekeeping and proper mosquito control measures in the construction sites all over Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: This combination of measures – onsite ECO, outreach, inspections, fines, SWOs – has helped us to bring about a significant reduction in the percentage of inspected construction sites found with mosquito breeding – from 30% in the 1990s to 11% in 2013 to about 9% today.

sections.label: Fines for home owners with breeding
sections.summary: Since 14 March 2016 NEA has taken enforcement action against all home owners found with mosquito breeding, and 2,200 households were fined between January and July this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Since 14 March 2016, NEA has taken enforcement action against all the home owners found with mosquito breeding, regardless of whether the homes are within the existing dengue clusters, and2,200 households were fined between January and July this year.

sections.label: Zika Mozzie Wipeout and CVPA orders
sections.summary: SCAL members will conduct Mozzie Wipeout exercises, and NEA served CVPA orders on four dormitories with stricter housekeeping and mosquito control requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: With the threat of Zika, all SCAL members will be conducting Mozzie Wipeout exercises in their sites in the next few weeks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: NEA has also served CVPA orders to four dormitories to impose stricter requirements on them to maintain good housekeeping, check for mosquito breeding, clear stagnant water regularly, carry out thermal fogging if the mosquito population is high, and mandatory residual spraying in their premises on a quarterly basis.

sections.label: Mosquito control strategy commended by WHO
sections.summary: Rigorous mosquito control and coordinated public education have been commended by WHO and US CDC, with everyone having a role against dengue and Zika.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Our strategy of rigorous mosquito control efforts and coordinated public education has been commended by WHO and US' Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Everyone – the Government agencies, premises owners, businesses, residents, the community – has a role in our fight against dengue and Zika.

sections.label: CVPA measures and ECO requirements
sections.summary: CVPA measures include an ECO on site for construction sites exceeding $50 million and a part-time one every two weeks for those between $10 million and $50 million.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The combination of the CVPA measures, which include having an ECO on site for those construction sites exceeding $50 million and a part-time one every two weeks for those between $10 million and $50 million, we think this is sufficient.

sections.label: CVPA extended to dormitories
sections.summary: CVPA was extended to dormitories as a precautionary measure, requiring owners to step up housekeeping and quarterly misting to kill mosquitoes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We are thankful that the SCAL continues to encourage the supervisors to be on the look-out, always be on their toes, so that whether it is their site or their workers, they must care for them enough not to allow the mosquitoes to breed and, therefore, spread Zika or dengue.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We have also extended our CVPA to the dormitories because it is a good precautionary measure, although this is not a construction site.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The workers live there and they may also spread or transmit to one another.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Therefore, CVPA will require the dormitory owners to step up their housekeeping of the premises as well as misting quarterly, to ensure that mosquitoes, if they were ever to exist in that place, will die if they were to land on the walls, because this is where most of them would be during the nights when they are resting.

sections.label: Section 36 orders in dengue areas
sections.summary: The question asks how many section 36 orders have been served under CVPA this year to inspect vacant or non-cooperative households in dengue or Zika areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Under CVPA, from the start of this year, how many section 36 orders have been served to inspect vacant or non-cooperative households in premises in dengue or Zika areas?

sections.label: Microcephaly cases per live births
sections.summary: Over the last five years, there were on average between five and 12 microcephaly cases per 10,000 live births.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Over the last five years, we had, on average, between five and 12 microcephaly cases per 10,000 live births.

sections.label: Singaporeans access Zika information
sections.summary: A recent MCI survey found more than 90% of Singaporeans found it easy to access Zika information.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Based on a recent survey by MCI, more than 90% of Singaporeans found it easy to access information with regard to Zika.

sections.label: Section 36 orders served
sections.summary: This year, 13 section 36 orders were served before Zika detection and 24 after, three with breeding but few larvae.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: To date, this year, before the detection of Zika, there were 13 section 36 orders served and, after Zika, 24 such orders were served.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Of these 24, three were found with breeding but with very few larvae.

sections.label: WHO advice on pregnant testing
sections.summary: WHO did not recommend routine testing for non-symptomatic pregnant women because the testing window is very narrow.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: On pregnant ladies, WHO did not recommend regular routine testing for non-symptomatic pregnant women because, to test them, there is a very narrow window.

sections.label: Subsidies, testing capacity, research funds
sections.summary: Public healthcare patients access the subsidy framework, testing capacity is sufficient with measures to increase it, and NMRC funds Zika research.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: For treatment in our public healthcare institutions, they will always have access to our subsidy framework.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Ms Tin asked about the capacity for testing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: We have sufficient capacity, in the meantime, to handle the daily testing that we are encountering, and we also have measures put in place to increase the capacity, if need be.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Our National Medical Research Council (NMRC) has funds to support meaningful research with regard to Zika.

sections.label: Virus strain and Wolbachia calibration
sections.summary: The Minister was asked to confirm if the Singapore strain matches Brazil's, and Wolbachia mosquitoes are being calibrated from October for about six months.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
sentences.text: Is the Minister able to confirm whether the current strain of virus in Singapore is similar to the one in Brazil and if that is not known yet, when does he expect to know whether it is the same strain?

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: We are calibrating the Wolbachia mosquitoes, so to speak, from October onwards, for about six months.

sections.label: Programme duration until 2020
sections.summary: The whole programme will take up to 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: The whole programme will take up to 2020.

sections.label: Singapore virus strain sequencing
sections.summary: A*STAR and National Public Health Laboratory scientists sequenced the virus and found the Singapore strain came from the Southeast Asian strain, not the Brazil strain.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Our scientists – the A*STAR scientists as well as the National Public Health Laboratory scientists – have worked together to sequence the virus and based on their analysis, the Singapore strain that we have discovered so far, came from the Southeast Asian strain, which is not the same as the strain in Brazil.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: In fact, the strain in Brazil is a later strain that was derived from the Asian strain.

sections.label: Mosquito breeding site rates
sections.summary: About 5,000 breeding sites were found in 638,000 homes, while 500 were found in 4,400 construction sites studied.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: The Minister mentioned that about 5,000 breeding sites were found in the 638,000 homes that were assessed.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: That adds up to about one breeding site per 128 homes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: On the other hand, the 5% figure means 500 breeding sites were found out of 4,400 construction sites studied.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: That means about one in nine construction sites has mosquito breeding sites discovered and destroyed.
